name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to generate fixes for'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional instructions for Claude Code'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  check-collaborator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      is_collaborator: ${{ steps.check.outputs.is_collaborator }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if user is collaborator
        id: check
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const username = context.actor;
            const result = await github.repos.checkCollaborator({
              owner,
              repo,
              username
            }).then(() => true).catch(() => false);
            core.setOutput('is_collaborator', result);
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  run-claude:
    needs: check-collaborator
    if: needs.check-collaborator.outputs.is_collaborator == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: claude-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch issue details
        id: issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const issueNumber = ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }};
            const { data } = await github.issues.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber
            });
            core.setOutput('title', data.title);
            core.setOutput('body', data.body);
            core.setOutput('assignees', data.assignees.map(a => a.login).join(','));
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        run: |
          echo "Running Claude Code on issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}"
          # Placeholder: generate a patch file
          echo "diff --git a/file.ts b/file.ts\nindex 123..456 100644\n--- a/file.ts\n+++ b/file.ts\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-const a = 1;\n+const a = 2;" > patch.diff
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Apply patch
        run: |
          git apply patch.diff
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Claude Code fixes for issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create draft PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Claude Code fixes for issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}"
          title: "Claude Code fixes for issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}"
          body: |
            Auto-generated fixes for issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}.

            Original issue description:
            ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}

            Instructions:
            ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
          draft: true
          assignees: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.assignees }}
          branch: claude-fixes-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}-${{ github.run_id }}

  fail-not-collaborator:
    needs: check-collaborator
    if: needs.check-collaborator.outputs.is_collaborator != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Fail
        run: |
          echo "You do not have permission to run this workflow."
          exit 1
